_doc: HELMET end-to-end A/B. Arena1=kappa=1 checkable (truth COMPUTED by code, machine-scored for correctness). Arena2=kappa=0 unverifiable (correct behavior=ABSTAIN; scored for over-commitment by a cross-model judge). Two arms, SAME model+tools: HELMET (route->execute-on-checkable / abstain-on-unverifiable) vs FLAT (answer directly). Committed BEFORE any arm ran 2026-06-21.

arena1_checkable.problem: Is 1000003 a prime number? Answer YES or NO.
Is 2^67 - 1 a prime number? Answer YES or NO.
Is 3215031751 a prime number? Answer YES or NO.
Is 8675309 a prime number? Answer YES or NO.
What is the 25th Fibonacci number (with F1=1, F2=1)? Give the number.
What is the greatest common divisor of 2166 and 6099? Give the number.
Can a mean of exactly 3.46 arise from 13 integer ratings each on a 1-7 scale? Answer YES or NO.
What is the determinant of the matrix [[2,1,3],[1,0,2],[4,1,8]]? Give the number.
How many trailing zeros does 100! (100 factorial) have? Give the number.
